You can't rely on workarounds or temporary fixes; you need a real solution that gives you full control over your commerce infrastructure. You need a sovereign commerce platform that doesn't depend on any third-party services. The question is, what are your real options for selling courses without Teachable or Stripe?
What Each Option Actually Offers

Let's start by examining the characteristics of each option. Gumroad is a popular platform for selling digital products, but it charges a 3.5% + 30¢ fee per sale and has a 14-day wait period for payouts. Lemon Squeezy offers a more advanced set of features, but it still relies on third-party payment processors and charges a 1% + 10¢ fee per sale. Meanwhile, NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment gateway that integrates directly with your website, charging a flat 0.5% fee per sale with no wait period for payouts. The key difference lies in the level of infrastructure control and fees associated with each option.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have limited support for regions like Nigeria. They might require additional documentation or impose higher fees, but ultimately, they're still dependent on third-party payment processors. NOWPayments, on the other hand, has no such restrictions and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments directly on your website. This means you can sell courses to customers in Nigeria without any issues or intermediaries.

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors to consider when choosing a commerce platform. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge higher fees and have longer wait periods for payouts, which can eat into your profits. NOWPayments, however, offers a flat 0.5% fee with no wait period for payouts, ensuring you receive your money quickly and efficiently. Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of a sovereign commerce platform. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy retain some control over your sales data and payment processing, while NOWPayments gives you full ownership and control over your commerce infrastructure. Automation is also a key benefit of NOWPayments, as it integrates seamlessly with your website and automates payment processing, reducing manual effort and errors. When it comes to delivery, NOWPayments allows you to send digital products directly to customers, eliminating the need for intermediaries.

Ultimately, the choice of commerce platform depends on your specific situation and needs. If you're looking for a simple, hassle-free solution, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy might be a good fit. However, if you want full control over your commerce infrastructure, lower fees, and faster payment processing, NOWPayments is the clear winner.
